remarks: Enjoy the best of Ellicottville resort living in this nicely updated studio-plus-loft townhouse, just a short walk to Holiday Valley Resort! Tucked toward the rear of the development, this location offers a quieter setting with slope views from your patio. You'll love seeing your favorite slopes shine at night. Inside, you'll find a fresh, inviting space featuring a newer kitchen, appliances, flooring, paint, and furnishings. The loft bedroom adds extra sleeping space and includes a convenient half bath. A spiral staircase with generous treads and a textured, slip-resistant finish provides access to the loft. Need more room for family and guests? The Queen-sized Murphy bed makes the main living area work double duty for relaxing by day and sleeping by night. Offered mostly furnished with just a few exclusions, this townhouse is ready to enjoy as your own getaway or four-season retreat. Walk to Holiday Valley for skiing, golf, and year-round activities, or take a healthy stroll into the nearby village of Ellicottville for its restaurants, shops, and lively resort-town atmosphere. A great opportunity to own your own piece of Ellicottville getaway living!
